summary: Comprehensive testing of LATAM Reportero Sanity CMS integration and Comments system. Backend APIs 100% passing (16/16 tests). Frontend pages load correctly with Sanity data. Comments gating working correctly for non-subscribers.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'Auth initialization timed out' message during page load, but functionality still works

issues: Console warning: Image with src logo.png has width/height modified without maintaining aspect ratio - add 'width: auto' or 'height: auto'

Backend: GET /api/sanity/article/{slug} returns single article with Portable Text body

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Sanity CMS integration features working. Homepage fetches articles via /api/sanity/articles proxy. Article detail pages render Portable Text body content correctly. Comments system properly gates non-subscribers (free/guest roles get 403). Paid roles (paid, subscriber, contributor, editor, admin) can create comments. Community page shows locked regional groups for non-subscribers.
